meta.title: Create custom order
meta.description: Create a custom order on Soff.uz — find the specialist you need for your project. Write your requirements, receive offers from freelancers and choose the best one.

videoBanner.title: Don't know how to place an order on SOFF?
videoBanner.subtitle: Video guide on how to place an order.

direction.label: Select direction
direction.infoPoint1: Choose a direction that matches your order, this will help you find specialists that match your requirements.
direction.infoPoint2: Each direction has a group of specialists specialized in its field, so choosing the most suitable option based on your project characteristics is important.
direction.infoPoint3: Choosing the right direction ensures quality and timely completion of your order.

category.label: Select category
category.info: Please select one of the following categories to properly direct your order. Each category corresponds to a specific type of service, so your choice plays an important role in finding the specialist you are looking for.
category.infoPoint1: Select from the list of available categories for each direction.
category.infoPoint2: Choosing the right category helps direct your order to the right specialist.

description.label: Enter order description
description.placeholder:
- Order topic or direction
- Required volume (pages, words, slides, etc.)
- Main requirements or plan
- What format is needed (Word, PDF, PPT, etc.)
- etc.
description.info: Please write your order topic and requirements clearly and understandably. This helps the executor complete the work quickly and correctly.
description.infoPoint1: Write the main requirements of your order clearly.
description.infoPoint2: Provide information about important details, deadlines and budget.
description.infoPoint3: If possible, share your previous work or samples.

fileUpload.maxSizeError: File cannot be larger than 50 MB

language.label: Order language
language.placeholder: In which language would you like it to be prepared?
language.infoPoint1: Choose one of Uzbek, Russian or English languages.
language.infoPoint2: The selected language will be used for order text and communication.

budget.label: Enter your budget
budget.info: Please write the budget you want to allocate for this work in soums.
budget.infoPoint1: Set your budget realistically, this will attract suitable specialists.
budget.infoPoint2: If your budget is limited, be open about it and discuss with specialists.

deadline.label: Set order completion deadline
deadline.datePlaceholder: Select order completion date and time
deadline.required: Please select delivery date and time!
deadline.infoPoint1: Set your deadline realistically, this will ensure quality work.
deadline.infoPoint2: If the order needs to be completed faster, discuss this with the specialist in advance.

modal.confirmQuestion: Do you confirm placing the order?
modal.point1: After creating the order, you will make 💳 payment
modal.point2: Qualified freelancers on our platform will present you with their offers with price and description
modal.point3: You will choose the freelancer that best suits you among them and start cooperation with them
